intent: tpunit fixture exercising the Jobs plugin's UpdateJob command: updating data/repeat/priority/nextRun, preserving numeric-looking string data values, updating mocked jobs, and clearing repeat via shouldClearRepeat.

objects.name: UpdateJobTest
objects.role: one fixture per test, creates a job, calls UpdateJob, then verifies the DB row

name_fit.note: Matches the UpdateJob command it tests.

location_fit.note: Grouped with other per-command Jobs plugin tests.

naming_quality.note: Consistent naming, but unlike most siblings this fixture has no per-test tearDown resetting the jobs table (only tearDownClass), which is a latent state-leak risk between tests rather than a naming issue per se.
